[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested famous sculptors and artists across various styles and periods, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Michelangelo Buonarroti (Italy, 1475-1564): A Renaissance master known for "David" and the Pietà.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Auguste Rodin (France, 1840-1917): Known for "The Thinker" and "The Kiss".  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Bernini (Italy, 1598-1680): Famous for "Ecstasy of Saint Teresa".  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Henry Moore (UK, 1898-1986): Known for abstract, biomorphic forms.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Constantin Brancusi (Romania/France, 1876-1957): Known for "Bird in Space".  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Alberto Giacometti (Switzerland, 1901-1966): Known for elongated human figures.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Claes Oldenburg (Sweden/USA, 1929-2022) and Coosje van Bruggen (Netherlands/USA, 1932-2009): Known for large-scale sculptures of everyday objects.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Anish Kapoor (India/UK, b. 1954): Known for "Cloud Gate" (The Bean).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Barbara Hepworth (UK, 1903-1975): Known for abstract forms and exploration of texture.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Isamu Noguchi (USA, 1904-1988): Known for abstract, geometric forms.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Richard Serra (USA, b. 1939): Known for large-scale, site-specific installations.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Rachel Whiteread (UK, b. 1963): Known for exploring themes of space and memory.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested other artists worth exploring, including Salvador Dalí, Pablo Picasso, Louise Bourgeois, and Takashi Murakami.
